cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: MarkupText documentation: ul-tag should be changed to u-tag
cases.description:
## Description of bug / unexpected behavior This fails with `ValueError: Unknown tag 'ul' on line 1 char 13` ```python class MarkupExample(Scene): def construct(self): text = MarkupText("
    underlined
") self.add(text) ``` ## Expected behavior The docstring in the code indicates that it should produce underlined text: https://github.com/ManimCommunity/manim/blob/9a84ec6a45f2ff4254d2243116f84bac074db551/manim/mobject/text/text_mobject.py#L897 Note that this does work: ```python class MarkupExample(Scene): def construct(self): text = MarkupText('underlined') self.add(text) ``` ## System specifications ``` Manim Community v0.18.0 ```

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fixes #3744 - underline tag should be <u></u> in the documentation.
